list_transfer_payments.description: Fetch completed payments used to fund the transfer. In most cases there should only be a single payment associated with the transfer. There are rare occasions that a transfer can be funded with multiple payment methods and when this occurs the first completed payment method would be used to calculate the fees provided on the quote.
list_transfer_payments.name: list_transfer_payments

parameters.description: The transfer ID
parameters.name: transfer_id

method.description: The payment method used to pay for the transfer

pricingVariant.description: The qualifier that allows to apply different pricing policy within the same payment method. Often the value might be the payment method itself

timeCreated.description: Date of when payment was created

timeUpdated.description: Date of when payment was updated

list_transfers.description: Get the list of transfers for a given user's profile (defaults to user's personal profile). You can add query parameters to specify user's profile (personal or business), time period and/or payment status. For example, you can query all failed payments created since last week, or all completed payments created since yesterday.
list_transfers.name: list_transfers

parameters.description: User profile ID. If parameter is omitted, defaults to user's personal profile
parameters.name: profile

parameters.description: Comma separated list of one or more status codes to filter transfers. See [Transfer statuses](/guides/product/send-money/tracking/transfer-statuses) for complete list of statuses.
parameters.name: status

parameters.name: source_currency

parameters.description: Target currency code
parameters.name: target_currency

parameters.description: Starting date to filter transfers, inclusive of the provided date
parameters.name: created_date_start

parameters.description: Ending date to filter transfers, inclusive of the provided date
parameters.name: created_date_end

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to be returned in response
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Starting record number
parameters.name: offset

customerTransactionId.description: Unique identifier randomly generated per transfer request by the calling client

hasActiveIssues.description: Are there any pending issues which stop executing the transfer?

payinSessionId.description: ID of the Payin Session generated for the transfer, which can be used for certain payin methods when funding the transfer

description: Read Wise profiles, balances, transfers, exchange rates and statements, and manage balance accounts.

wise_new_profile_trigger.description: Watches a complete, bounded resource snapshot. Existing records establish the first baseline; new records start the workflow afterwards. Failed pages retain the saved place. Polling follows your workspace plan; scans are limited to 4,000 records.

wise_new_transfer_trigger.description: Watches a complete, bounded resource snapshot. Existing records establish the first baseline; new records start the workflow afterwards. Failed pages retain the saved place. Polling follows your workspace plan; scans are limited to 4,000 records.

wise_transfer_changed_trigger.description: Watches a complete, bounded resource snapshot. Existing records establish the first baseline; new records and changes start the workflow afterwards. Failed pages retain the saved place. Polling follows your workspace plan; scans are limited to 4,000 records.
